sections.excerpt:
DILUTION The price of the current
offering is fixed at $0.06 per share. This price is significantly higher than the price paid by the Company’s officer for common
equity since the Company’s inception on June 1, 2026. Ms. Catiene Machado Albuquerque Assumpcao, our Director, acquired 1,800,000
shares of common stock on July 31, 2026 at $0.001 per share, for aggregate consideration of $1,800. The consideration was non-cash and
was satisfied by her payment of expenses on our behalf, as described under “Certain Relationships and Related Transactions.”
The shares owned by our Director, as identified in this registration statement, are not being offered for resale under this registration.
